newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline was slightly firmer on NYMEX gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline was slightly firmer on NYMEX gains.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firmer on Thursday after strong gains in NYMEX unleaded futures broke the stalemate which dogged the market on Wednesday, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded once at $210 fob Rotterdam for first half June delivery and later at the same level for pre-end May.
A regular barge traded at $201.50 for end-May delivery.
Traders attributed gasoline's strength to gains by NYMEX unleaded futures in Wednesday's session.
NYMEX June unleaded futures closed 1.14 cents higher at 66.53 cents a gallon on Wednesday and was traded at a 0.13 cent lower on ACCESS.
"I think the market was in stalemate yesterday; the unleaded gains gave some direction," one trader said.
On the cargo front, prices remained firm as a scarcity of cargoes supported higher prices.
Premium unleaded cif NWE cargoes were assessed around the $216/$219 range.
There was talk that some players might be looking to the barge market to build cargoes.
